title: QuadPE balancing extension
abstract: A synthetic parked extension that would balance multiple protected components but is retained only for provenance because it adds complexity before the primary causal gate is resolved.
disposition_reason: Added system complexity is unjustified until the primary motif-panel mechanism is supported.
strongest_reason: It anticipates stoichiometric imbalance if multiple protected components are later combined.
weakest_causal_edge: There is no evidence that balancing, rather than the primary gate, is currently limiting.
pairwise_summary: Not eligible for comparison while the upstream mechanism remains unresolved.
reviewer_disagreement: No material disagreement; reviewers agreed to park the extension.
reviewer_critiques: Do not optimize multi-component balance before showing that the core gate changes the intended state.
reentry_condition: Re-enter only after the primary panel is supported and a measurable component imbalance appears.
scientific_summary: The extension would tune multiple protected components only after the primary mechanism is established.
causal_mechanism: Component balancing would narrow stoichiometric variance across a larger architecture.
evidence_basis: Synthetic systems-level reasoning without direct evidence of a present balancing bottleneck.
next_discriminating_experiment: No experiment is currently recommended; first establish the primary motif-panel effect and quantify component imbalance.
